piping_browser_journeys.description: Desktop browser specs the product job runs on one Chromium project. The core specs run whenever the job runs. A group's specs are added when the PR diff changes one of its paths, including the specs themselves, and for shared or unmatched inputs and full coverage. Paths are project-relative.
